system.description: Two Tremere who each cast this ancient dueling rite while standing in linked ritual circles may spend exactly two Blood Traits per turn regardless of generation, and may spend one Blood Trait to pit Willpower directly against the opponent's Thaumaturgy in a resisted test. While in effect, every thaumaturgical action either combatant takes is highlighted to both, allowing Occult-based recognition and active defense against incoming powers. The circle ends in death, submission, or the ruling of a neutral arbiter, and cathbreaking its terms marks a Tremere as untrustworthy among the clan.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
